content.title: Arrange shipping and delivery for an enterprise order
content.description: A Buyer or Procurement Manager chooses a saved site or enters a new ship-to location, completes the required address and optional tax fields for a supported country, is blocked on invalid country-specific postal or exemption formats, selects an eligible delivery method, and receives tax, delivery cost, and estimated delivery date calculations that account for discounts, services, backorder lead time, geography, and order size.
content.summary: Capture ship-to details and delivery method.
content.value: Ensures the order can be delivered with correct tax and fulfillment charges.
criteria: Ship-to selection offers the account's saved sites, such as `HQ — San Jose` and `EU Hub — Frankfurt`, and also allows entry of a new site.
Required ship-to fields are company name, attention (recipient name), street address line 1, city, state/province, postal code, country, and phone number.
Optional ship-to fields are street address line 2 and tax exemption certificate number.
Supported countries are United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Japan, and India; an invalid postal code format for the selected country hard-blocks submission.

Tax is 8.25% of discounted hardware plus services; a tax exemption certificate matching `EXM-` followed by 6 digits sets tax to $0.00; any other format shows `Invalid exemption certificate format (EXM-123456)` and blocks submission.

Delivery methods are Standard Ground (5–7 business days, free if hardware subtotal ≥ $5,000 otherwise $49, all countries), Expedited (2–3 business days, $199 per order, United States and Canada), and White-Glove Deployment (10 business days, $75 per device, United States only and 25 or more devices on the order).
Estimated delivery date is calculated as today plus the quote's longest backorder lead time, if any, plus the selected delivery window, counted in business days.
